unsupported: Based in Idaho Falls, Idaho, CES (Columbia Electric Supply) operates as a local integrated partner for industrial manufacturers across the Intermountain West.
Its portfolio includes Rockwell Automation motor-control products such as the M100 line, the FactoryXT smart-manufacturing platform, and Grace Technologies ChekVolt voltage testers.
Its client base consists of plant operators and engineering teams looking to modernize existing facilities or deploy new automation systems.
